operations.name: get_my_own_details
operations.description: Get profile details for the authenticated user. This is the same as GET `/people/{personId}` using the Person ID associated with your Auth token.

operations.name: invitees_create_a_meeting_invitee
operations.description: * Invite a person to attend a meeting.

operations.name: invitees_delete_a_meeting_invitee
operations.description: Removes a meeting invitee identified by a `meetingInviteeId` specified in the URI. The deleted meeting invitee cannot be recovered.

operations.name: invitees_get_a_meeting_invitee
operations.description: Retrieve details for a meeting invitee identified by a `meetingInviteeId` in the URI.

operations.name: invitees_list_meeting_invitees
operations.description: Lists meeting invitees for a meeting with a specified `meetingId`. You can set a maximum number of invitees to return.

operations.name: invitees_update_a_meeting_invitee
operations.description: Update details for a meeting invitee identified by a `meetingInviteeId` in the URI.

operations.name: list_rooms
operations.description: List rooms to which the authenticated user belongs to.

operations.name: meetings_createmeeting
operations.description: Creates a new meeting. Regular users can schedule up to 100 meetings in 24 hours and admin users up to 3000 overall or 800 for a single user. Please note that the failed requests are also counted toward the limits.

operations.name: meetings_deletemeeting
operations.description: <div>

operations.name: meetings_getmeetingbyid
operations.description: Retrieves details for a meeting with a specified meeting ID.

operations.name: meetings_listmeetings
operations.description: The previous `List Meetings of a Meeting Series` API is merged into the [List Meetings](/docs/api/v1/meetings/list-meetings) API.

operations.name: meetings_updatemeeting
operations.description: <div>

operations.name: memberships_create_a_membership
operations.description: Add someone to a room by Person ID or email address, optionally making them a moderator. Compliance Officers cannot add people to empty (team) spaces.

operations.name: memberships_delete_a_membership
operations.description: Deletes a membership by ID.

operations.name: memberships_get_membership_details
operations.description: Get details for a membership by ID.

operations.name: memberships_list_memberships
operations.description: Lists all room memberships. By default, lists memberships for rooms to which the authenticated user belongs.

operations.name: memberships_update_a_membership
operations.description: Updates properties for a membership by ID.

operations.name: messages_create_a_message
operations.description: Post a plain text or [rich text](/docs/basics#formatting-messages) message, and optionally, a [file attachment](/docs/basics#message-attachments) attachment, to a room.

operations.name: messages_delete_a_message
operations.description: Delete a message, by message ID.

operations.name: messages_edit_a_message
operations.description: Update a message you have posted not more than 10 times.

operations.name: messages_get_message_details
operations.description: Show details for a message, by message ID.

operations.name: messages_list_direct_messages
operations.description: List all messages in a 1:1 (direct) room. Use the `personId` or `personEmail` query parameter to specify the room. Each message will include content attachments if present.

operations.name: messages_list_messages
operations.description: Lists all messages in a room.  Each message will include content attachments if present.

operations.name: people_get_person_details
operations.description: Shows details for a person, by ID.

operations.name: people_list_people
operations.description: List people in your organization. For most users, either the `email` or `displayName` parameter is required. Admin users can omit these fields and list all users in their organization.

operations.name: recordings_deleterecordingbyrecordid
operations.description: Removes a recording with a specified recording ID. The deleted recording cannot be recovered. If a Compliance Officer deletes another user's recording, the recording will be inaccessible to regular users (host, attendees and shared), but will be still available to the Compliance Officer.

operations.name: recordings_getrecordbyrecordid
operations.description: Retrieves details for a recording with a specified recording ID.

operations.name: rooms_delete_a_room
operations.description: Deletes a room, by ID. Deleted rooms cannot be recovered.

operations.description: Shows details for a team membership, by ID.

operations.name: team_memberships_update_a_team_membership
